nodes.name: Andrew Kolvet
nodes.description: Subject of host's text exchange about post-assassination dream of Charlie Kirk; previously identified in earlier episodes as orchestrating PR operations against the host.

nodes.name: Johnny Moore
nodes.description: Former Liberty University lead pastor (left 2014); founder of Chyros Company; claimed in this episode to be a disciple of Ron Godwin. Self-identifies in audio as involved with ADL and Aspen Institute.

nodes.name: Ron Godwin
nodes.description: Identified in this episode as Johnny Moore's mentor and as a declared disciple of Sun Myung Moon; retired from Liberty University in October 2014.

nodes.name: Sun Myung Moon
nodes.description: Founder of the Unification Church (transcript spells inconsistently as "Sunyong Moon" / "Sun Young Moon" / "Sun Myung Moon"); source of the three disciples quotation.

nodes.name: Jerry Falwell Jr.
nodes.description: Identified in this episode as ousted from Liberty University; co-established the Falwell Center with Charlie Kirk in 2021; replaced by Jerry Prevo.

nodes.name: Mark Burnett
nodes.description: Reality TV producer named in this episode as Johnny Moore's employer in Hollywood (post-2015) and chairperson of MGM (acquired Summerhouse).

nodes.name: Unnamed Likud Knesset Speaker
nodes.description: Knesset member who delivered the speech declaring Tucker Carlson and Candace Owens enemies of Israel; name not stated in episode.

nodes.name: Jerry Prevo
nodes.description: Identified in this episode as named successor to Jerry Falwell Jr. at Liberty University; first act allegedly was firing Charlie Kirk and reinstating Johnny Moore on a monthly retainer.

nodes.name: Tetsuya Yamagami
nodes.description: Identified in this episode as the 41-year-old assassin of Shinzō Abe; stated to have been driven to destitution by the Unification Church's influence on his mother.

nodes.name: Shinzō Abe
nodes.description: Longtime Prime Minister of Japan; assassinated; family identified as having long-running ties to the Unification Church.

nodes.name: Candace Owens Dream Vision of Andrew Kolbett
nodes.description: Persistent investigative target tracking the host's reported recurring dream in which Charlie Kirk appeared and revealed Andrew Kolbett's face; framed by host as prophetic of Kolbett's role in PR operations.

claims.label: Text message from Candace Owens to Andrew Kolbett described Charlie Kirk dream stating he was betrayed and Andrew knew more than publicly stated
claims.claim: The host presented a text message she sent to Andrew Kolbett describing a recurring dream in which Charlie Kirk stated he was betrayed, that "they" were hiding what happened "to my left," and that Kolbett "know[s] much more than you've said publicly or privately."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain verification of the text exchange; identify the date and any reply correspondence; corroborate with any other recipients who received analogous communications.

claims.label: Andrew Kolbett never replied to the dream text from Candace Owens
claims.claim: The host stated that Andrew Kolbett did not respond to her text message and that this was the last time they spoke.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify non-reply independently; cross-check any subsequent communication records between the two parties.

claims.label: Christianity Today reported Johnny Moore arrived at Liberty University dorms at age 14
claims.claim: Christianity Today published that "Johnny Moore was only 14 when he first stayed in the dorms at Liberty University" and that he had remained at the school founded by Jerry Falwell Senior.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original Christianity Today article; identify author, publication date, and full article context.

claims.label: Johnny Moore and his single mother family briefly lived in Liberty University dorms following parental divorce and temporary homelessness
claims.claim: Christianity Today reported that Moore and his single-mother family briefly lived in Liberty University dorms after his parents' divorce and a temporary stretch of homelessness.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve original Christianity Today article and corroborate against any independent biographical sources.

claims.label: New York Times reported 180 LDP lawmakers had ties to the Unification Church
claims.claim: The New York Times reported that an internal audit by Japan's Liberal Democratic Party found approximately 180 elected lawmakers (almost half of the party's parliamentary membership) had accepted donations from or attended events of the Unification Church and related organizations.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the cited New York Times article; verify exact figures and any subsequent party responses.

claims.label: Johnny Moore stated he is involved with ADL and Aspen Institute civil society fellowship
claims.claim: In audio played on the episode, Johnny Moore stated he is "a part of the ADL and Aspen Institute civil society… in fellowship."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Moore's listed fellowships directly through ADL and Aspen Institute public records.

claims.label: Johnny Moore stated he serves on the ADL and Aspen Institute advisory board
claims.claim: Johnny Moore stated in the audio clip that he is on the advisory board for the Aspen Institute and ADL civil society fellowship.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify advisory board membership through both organizations' published directories.

claims.label: Johnny Moore stated commitment to building a "great wall of Christian Zionism"
claims.claim: Johnny Moore stated in audio that he is committed to "building a great wall of Christian Zionism all over the world to push back the forces of anti-semitism."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original venue and date of this speech; verify exact wording through primary source.

claims.label: Sun Myung Moon declared Ron Godwin as one of three disciples
claims.claim: The host presented a Sun Myung Moon quotation declaring Ron Godwin to be one of three disciples, charged with multiplying their own disciples.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the primary source (Unification Church publication, sermon, or recorded address) containing this declaration; verify date and venue.

claims.label: Sun Myung Moon's quoted instruction: each disciple must multiply three disciples of their own
claims.claim: The host presented a Sun Myung Moon quotation stating: "Each one of you will put yourself in Jesus's position and multiply three disciples of your own."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve primary source; verify whether this directive was organizational doctrine or rhetorical.

claims.label: A Likud party representative declared Tucker Carlson and Candace Owens enemies of Israel in a Knesset speech
claims.claim: An unidentified Likud party member, speaking in the Knesset, declared Tucker Carlson and Candace Owens "a new enemy rising from within" the West and accused them of "intellectual vandalism."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the Knesset speaker; obtain Knesset record of the speech; verify date and verbatim transcript.

claims.label: Megyn Kelly stated she received messages from pro-Israel Jewish friends who then turned against her
claims.claim: Megyn Kelly stated in interview that pro-Israel Jewish friends sent her notes thanking her for making them feel safer, and that the same people subsequently turned against her and called her an anti-Semite.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full interview transcript from Tucker Carlson show; identify named individuals if possible.

claims.label: Megyn Kelly stated she was called anti-Semite for refusing to condemn Candace Owens
claims.claim: Megyn Kelly stated in interview that she was accused of anti-Semitism specifically because she would not denounce Candace Owens.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify accusers; obtain interview transcript.

claims.label: Megyn Kelly stated she was called a coward by Ben Shapiro at Turning Point Amfest event
claims.claim: Megyn Kelly stated in interview that Ben Shapiro called her a coward at the Turning Point Amfest event in December for her refusal to denounce Candace Owens.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain video of Amfest remarks; verify date, exact wording, and surrounding context.

claims.investigative_direction: Requires corroboration through independent sources documenting Erica Kirk's professional role in establishing the Falwell Center. Flag as currently unsubstantiated beyond fan commentary.
